ValidationRule.description: Only SysAdmin, Carmen, & Babita can change/edit regional director field on EDU accounts in the US. SAL-3521
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000ErGiZQAV', /*carmen*/ $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000EVTGWQA5', /*babita*/ ISCHANGED(Regional_Director__c), RecordType.Name = 'Education', OR( ShippingCountry = 'USA', ShippingCountry = 'United States')) && Acc_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please contact your manager to request a change of Regional Director for this account.
